item.title: Presidents' Day protest at ICE office in Indianapolis
item.description: Dozens of people gathered in a parking lot across the street Monday afternoon with signs to oppose President Donald Trump and his administration’s immigration enforcement.

item.title: State tackles penny-rounding policies amid national shortage
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are crafting statewide penny-rounding policies as Hoosier retailers struggle through a nationwide shortage of the discontinued coin, but admit it needs more work. State revenues could also suffer.

item.title: Statehouse may finally be poised to pass township reform
item.description: Lawmakers have long considered ways to reduce township government. Legislative efforts may finally be set up to pass.

item.title: Child well-being rating improves for Indiana, but some trends remain 'worse'
item.description: Indiana’s children are faring better than they were a year ago, according to an annual review of child well-being. The State of the Child presentation at the Indiana Statehouse this week highlighted new data that examines youth outcomes including health, education, economic and family factors.

item.title: Lawmakers demand answers after ICE detainee dies at Miami Correctional Facility
item.description: Lawmakers are responding to the death of an ICE detainee at the Miami Correctional Facility north of Kokomo.

item.title: Ivy Tech is getting a mission makeover. Here's what could change
item.description: Legislation would reshape Ivy Tech Community College governance, add workforce-focused board expertise and require research aligning degrees with employer needs.

item.title: Lawmakers want to get people off the streets. Advocates argue their strategy will land people in jail
item.description: Lawmakers want to get people off the streets. Advocates argue their strategy will land people in jail. Some police joined opposition to the bill, arguing it could saddle jails with managing homeless people

item.title: Chicago Bears 'committed' to final steps in move to Indiana
item.description: The Chicago Bears could move to Indiana as lawmakers pass legislation aimed at securing a stadium deal for the football team.

item.title: Health department to track air pollution in West Indianapolis
item.description: After more than a century of exposure to pollution from multiple sources that has led to higher rates of lung cancer and lung disease than in other parts of the county, West Indianapolis will soon have its own network of air monitors.

item.title: Trump-aligned immigration bill would mandate cities, schools cooperate with ICE
item.description: Indiana's Senate Bill 76, a sweeping measure to align local law enforcement and public institutions with federal immigration enforcement, remains poised for final approval despite a delay in the Senate on Thursday.
